userStories.title: Create User database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy User model in backend/src/models/user.py with fields: id (UUID primary key), email (unique string, indexed), name (string), timezone (string, default 'UTC'), phone_number (string, nullable), created_at (datetime with timezone), updated_at (datetime with timezone, auto-update on change).
acceptanceCriteria: All fields have proper Python type hints
Email field has unique=True and index=True
Model is imported and exported in backend/src/models/__init__.py
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Call database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy Call model in backend/src/models/call.py with fields: id (UUID), user_id (FK to User, indexed), status (Enum: scheduled, in_progress, completed, failed), scheduled_at (datetime nullable), started_at (datetime nullable), ended_at (datetime nullable), created_at (datetime), updated_at (datetime). Include relationship to User.
acceptanceCriteria: CallStatus enum defined with all status values
Foreign key relationship to User model
Relationship back_populates configured on both models
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Transcript database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy Transcript model in backend/src/models/transcript.py with fields: id (UUID), call_id (FK to Call, indexed), speaker (Enum: agent, user), content (Text), timestamp_ms (Integer - milliseconds from call start), created_at (datetime). Include relationship to Call.
acceptanceCriteria: Speaker enum defined with 'agent' and 'user' values
Foreign key relationship to Call model
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Summary database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy Summary model in backend/src/models/summary.py with fields: id (UUID), call_id (FK to Call, unique - one summary per call), yesterday (Text - what was done yesterday), today (Text - plans for today), blockers (Text nullable - any blockers), raw_summary (Text - full AI-generated summary), posted_to_slack (boolean default false), slack_message_id (string nullable), created_at (datetime).
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key to Call with unique constraint (one summary per call)
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Schedule database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy Schedule model in backend/src/models/schedule.py with fields: id (UUID), user_id (FK to User), enabled (boolean default true), cron_expression (string - e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' for weekdays 9am), next_run_at (datetime nullable), created_at (datetime), updated_at (datetime).
acceptanceCriteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Alembic migration for all models
userStories.description: Generate Alembic migration that creates all tables (users, calls, transcripts, summaries, schedules) with proper relationships, indexes, and constraints. The migration should be reversible.
acceptanceCriteria: Indexes created on user_id columns and email
uv run alembic upgrade head succeeds (test with Supabase)

userStories.title: Create Pydantic schemas for API
userStories.description: Create Pydantic schemas in backend/src/api/schemas.py for all models: UserCreate, UserRead, UserUpdate, CallCreate, CallRead, CallUpdate, TranscriptRead, SummaryRead, ScheduleCreate, ScheduleRead, ScheduleUpdate. Use proper typing and field validation.
acceptanceCriteria: UUID fields use proper Pydantic UUID type
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Users API endpoints
userStories.description: Create CRUD endpoints for users in backend/src/api/routes/users.py: GET /users (list), GET /users/{id} (get one), POST /users (create), PATCH /users/{id} (update), DELETE /users/{id} (delete). Use async SQLAlchemy sessions and return proper Pydantic schemas.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Calls API endpoints
userStories.description: Create CRUD endpoints for calls in backend/src/api/routes/calls.py: GET /calls (list, with user_id filter), GET /calls/{id} (get one with transcripts and summary), POST /calls (create), PATCH /calls/{id} (update status), DELETE /calls/{id}. Include nested transcript and summary data in responses.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Schedules API endpoints
userStories.description: Create CRUD endpoints for schedules in backend/src/api/routes/schedules.py: GET /schedules (list, with user_id filter), GET /schedules/{id}, POST /schedules (create), PATCH /schedules/{id} (update), DELETE /schedules/{id}.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Write API integration tests
userStories.description: Create integration tests in backend/tests/test_api.py that test the users, calls, and schedules endpoints. Use pytest-asyncio and create fixtures for test database setup. Tests should create, read, update, and delete records.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes all tests

userStories.title: Set up React Query provider in frontend
userStories.description: Configure TanStack React Query in the frontend. Create a QueryClientProvider wrapper in frontend/src/lib/query-client.ts and wrap the app in frontend/src/app/layout.tsx. Configure default options for stale time and retry behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: File frontend/src/lib/query-client.ts exists with QueryClient config
QueryClientProvider wraps the app in layout.tsx
Default staleTime and retry options configured

userStories.title: Create dashboard layout shell
userStories.description: Create a dashboard layout in frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx with a sidebar navigation (Home, Call History, Schedule, Settings) and main content area. Use Tailwind CSS for styling. The sidebar should be responsive (collapsible on mobile).

userStories.title: Create call history page
userStories.description: Create the call history page at frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/calls/page.tsx. Display a list of calls with status, date, and duration. Include empty state when no calls exist. Create API hooks in frontend/src/lib/api/calls.ts using React Query.
acceptanceCriteria: File frontend/src/lib/api/calls.ts exists with useCallsQuery hook
Call list displays status, date, duration
Empty state shown when no calls

userStories.title: Create call detail page
userStories.description: Create call detail page at frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/calls/[id]/page.tsx. Show call info, transcript (if available), and summary (if available). Use React Query to fetch call with nested data.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays call status and timing info
Shows transcript entries in conversation format

userStories.title: Create schedule management page
userStories.description: Create schedule page at frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/schedule/page.tsx. Allow users to view and edit their call schedule. Include a form to set schedule time and days of week. Create API hooks in frontend/src/lib/api/schedules.ts.

userStories.title: Create home dashboard page
userStories.description: Create the home/dashboard page at frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx. Show a summary: next scheduled call, recent calls count, quick actions (trigger manual call button placeholder). Redirect from root / to this dashboard.

userStories.title: Create summary generation service
userStories.description: Create backend/src/services/summary_service.py that uses Anthropic Claude API to generate structured summaries from call transcripts. Extract: yesterday's work, today's plans, blockers. Use structlog for logging.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create summary API endpoint
userStories.description: Create endpoint POST /calls/{id}/summarize in backend/src/api/routes/calls.py that generates a summary for a completed call. The endpoint should get transcripts, call summary service, save summary to DB, and return it.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 400 if call has no transcripts
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Slack integration service
userStories.description: Create backend/src/services/slack_service.py that posts standup summaries to Slack. Use httpx for API calls (not the slack_sdk to keep deps light). Support posting formatted messages with yesterday/today/blockers sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Function post_summary(summary: Summary, user: User) -> str (returns message_id)
Uses httpx to call Slack API
Formats message with sections for each standup part
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create Slack posting endpoint
userStories.description: Create endpoint POST /summaries/{id}/post-to-slack in a new backend/src/api/routes/summaries.py. This posts an existing summary to Slack and updates the summary record with posted_to_slack=True and slack_message_id.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 400 if already posted (optional: allow repost)
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Add Slack posting UI to call detail
userStories.description: Update frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/calls/[id]/page.tsx to add a 'Post to Slack' button on summaries that haven't been posted. Show success/error feedback. Disable button and show posted status if already posted.
acceptanceCriteria: Post to Slack button on summary section
Shows 'Posted to Slack' badge if posted

userStories.title: Create LiveKit agent skeleton
userStories.description: Create backend/src/agent/standup_agent.py with a basic LiveKit VoicePipelineAgent setup. Import necessary LiveKit components, set up the agent class, but use placeholder/mock STT and TTS for now. The agent should be runnable with 'livekit-agents start'.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent can be started (even if just with mocks)
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Implement standup conversation flow
userStories.description: Update backend/src/agent/standup_agent.py to implement the full standup conversation flow: greet user, ask about yesterday, ask about today, ask about blockers, thank and end. Store conversation state and transcript entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Asks 'What are you planning to work on today?'
Asks 'Any blockers or things you need help with?'
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create manual call trigger endpoint
userStories.description: Create endpoint POST /calls/trigger in backend/src/api/routes/calls.py that creates a new call record, starts the LiveKit agent (or prepares the room), and returns the call ID and connection info. This is for testing the voice agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates or returns LiveKit room info
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Wire up manual call button in UI
userStories.description: Update the dashboard home page to make the 'Start Call' button functional. When clicked, it should call POST /calls/trigger and then navigate to a call-in-progress page or show connection info.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigates to call page or shows room info on success
